writeAPIKeyUse.reason: Existing usage telemetry updates at most one API key and one grant through native SQL JSON expressions (writeAPIKeyUseRows), with unchanged minute/revocation predicates and canonical hooks. Flag off unchanged: the same SQL stamp and in-memory mirror of the resident copy (apiKeyUseMirror). On a bounded store the post-commit patch goes to the installed logical generation instead of the policy-only copy (publishBoundedAPIKeyUse: first record with the id, unless revoked there, takes the use time natively; unknown stamp; no decode or policy change; no request work), exactly the legacy patch of the resident copy, so cold listings and later OAuth writes that re-marshal installed keys see lastUsedAt whenever the legacy copy has it. TestScaleP21M1APIKeyTelemetryDifferential compares exact canonical key/grant bytes for active and revoked records, selected-empty scope and oversized unrelated settings; TestScaleP21SW293APIKeyUseDifferential compares legacy and bounded warm state, rows and SQL-reloaded state for active, revoked, key-only, absent, duplicate inline and minute-skipped records; TestScaleP21SW430OAuthColdRoutes and TestScaleP21SW431OAuthExchangeSweepDifferential compare the installed image with a reload after real Bearer authentication. Credential lookup consumers remain independently blocked.
